statement:
∀ (f f' : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ),
  a < b → ContinuousOn f (Icc a b) → (∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) → f a = f b → ∃ c ∈ Ioo a b, f' c = 0

universal.type: ∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x
universal.name: hd

hyps.text: ∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x
hyps.name: hd

goal.text: ∃ c ∈ Ioo a b, f' c = 0
